Guard Guard is a bottom position where you use your legs, hips, and frames to control the person on top. Read more →
Open Guard Open guard is a guard position where the bottom player uses the legs actively without locking the ankles around the top player. Read more →

Knee Line Knee line is the position of the knee relative to a leg entanglement or lower-body control. Whether the knee is trapped, hidden, cleared, or exposed often changes how strong the control or escape is. Read more →
Inside Position Inside position means winning the space between your partner's arms or legs so your connections are more direct, safer, and easier to build from. Read more →
Leg Entanglement Leg entanglement is a lower-body control relationship where the legs are connected in a way that limits movement and creates attack or control options. Read more →
Sweep A sweep is a move from the bottom that puts you on top. Read more →

Knee Shield A knee shield is a half-guard frame where the bottom player places the knee across the top player's torso to create space, manage pressure, and make it harder to get flattened. Read more →
Half Guard Half guard is a position where one of the top player’s legs is trapped between the bottom player’s legs. Read more →
Frame A frame is a body structure that helps you create space and block pressure. Read more →
Underhook An underhook is when your arm goes under your partner's arm to gain connection, lift, turn, or control their upper body. Read more →
Guard Retention Guard retention is the skill of keeping your guard or rebuilding it when the top player is trying to pass around, through, or over your legs. Read more →
